# Wellcome Collection printer ornaments

Source work: [*English printers' ornaments* by Henry R. Plomer](https://wellcomecollection.org/works/k45mrrer), published in 1924. Plomer compiled the volume; its historical ornaments have multiple unidentified original designers. The Art Nouveau leaf border on scanned page 267 is explicitly captioned “Designs from the Foundry of Messrs P. M. Shanks & Sons, Ltd.” The foundry is credited as shown, without naming an individual artist.

The [Wellcome Collection work page](https://wellcomecollection.org/works/k45mrrer) and the bundled [IIIF rights evidence](records/manifest-evidence.json) mark the work **Public Domain Mark 1.0**. Wellcome's rights statement says it can be copied, modified, distributed, and used commercially without permission. Public Domain Mark describes the work's rights status; it is not CC0. Attribution is recommended by Wellcome but is not required. Each generated asset retains Wellcome's recommended credit, the specific scan ID and printed page, its original scan, the crop coordinates, and hashes of both the original and transparent derivative in [SOURCE-MANIFEST.json](SOURCE-MANIFEST.json).

The source scans are bundled unchanged in `originals/`. `node scripts/ingest-wellcome-printers-ornaments.mjs` extracts selected ornaments, removes the scanned paper background from the Studio derivatives, and regenerates the source manifest and asset metadata. The original scans remain available to audit or rework a crop. The selected items are decorative borders, flourishes, and print ornaments. Plates with religious iconography, royal arms, or text were excluded from this Studio pack.
